name: google_calendar
description: View or create events on the user's primary Google Calendar. Call with action='upcoming' for the next events, action='today' for today's schedule, or action='create' with a title and ISO 8601 start/end times to add a new event.

action.description: upcoming: list next events. today: list today's events. create: add a new event (requires title, start, end).

start.description: Event start time as a full ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. '2026-06-22T14:00:00'). Required for action='create'. Resolve relative phrases like 'tomorrow at 2pm' into an actual timestamp using the current time from the system prompt.

end.description: Event end time as a full ISO 8601 timestamp. Required for action='create'. If the user doesn't specify a duration, default to 1 hour after start.

description.description: Optional event description/notes. Only used for action='create'.

limit.description: Max number of events to return for action='upcoming'. Defaults to 10.
